channel.title: The News International - National
channel.description: National news from The News International

item.title: Pakistan, IMF conclude talks with staff-level agreement in hand
item.description: Islamabad and the IMF concluded a round of negotiations with a staff-level agreement on the pending tranche, officials confirmed on Friday.

item.title: Cabinet approves summary for new power tariff relief scheme
item.description: The federal cabinet approved a relief package aimed at easing electricity tariffs for domestic consumers ahead of winter.

item.title: Punjab CM launches new health card program in Multan
item.description: Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz inaugurated an expanded health card scheme covering free treatment for low-income families.

item.title: Interior ministry issues fresh security alert for major cities
item.description: The interior ministry directed provincial governments to heighten security in major cities following intelligence reports of a possible threat.

item.title: KP assembly passes resolution condemning cross-border attacks
item.description: Lawmakers in the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa assembly unanimously passed a resolution condemning recent cross-border militant attacks.

item.title: President Zardari to address joint session of parliament next week
item.description: President Asif Ali Zardari is scheduled to address a joint session of parliament next week on the government's legislative agenda.
